_comment: Local Blaze server identity and client configuration, reconstructed from the retail FIFA 21 PC trace. {fut}, {easw}, {ssf} and {ssfClientId} are replaced by the local service ports and the SSF OAuth client id. OSDK_CORE's two DISABLE_ONLINE_* keys are the production Python server's (SQUAD_MATCH_PARITY and DISABLE_ONLINE_LINEUP_CHECK): FIFA21.exe's kickoff lineup check 0x1443e4760 otherwise ends every Rivals match (EndOnlineGame 12), and ComputeOnlineSquadsCRC 0x144641350 would compare two local installs' database CRCs because this server distributes no online squad file. FIFA_SETTING_ENABLE_ALT_TAB_DISCONNECTS 1 keeps retail alt-tab disconnects: when the window loses focus during an online game (game manager out of state 0), FIFA21.exe reads the key with default 1 (0x14431af37) and, at 1, ends the online game with EndOnlineGame 11 (sent to the game as GameEndedReason 12 ALTTAB); CardsDLL's FUT match handler reads the same key (0x18006a7a2). Any value but 1 skips both, and from 10-07 to 10-08 the server sent 0: an alt-tabbed FIFA then paused and froze its lockstep opponent, which players used to force wins, so it is 1 again (session 13 RE, commit 52b2bae8 docs/rivals-advance-findings.md; the Python server's opt-in LOCALFUT21_ALT_TAB_DISCONNECTS_OFF, same position after FIFA_POW_URL).
_statsComment: Stats leaderboards (Top Players, Leaderboards): period counters count days, weeks and months since January 1st of epochYear; every board ranks one stat, the club's Rivals skill rating.
_matchmakingComment: Matchmade Rivals games: the protocol version sent when the host's StartMatchmaking names none, and the game name and UUID prefixes (followed by the game id).
_onlineComment: The online-match wire values the production Python server ran with (flag bank prod-flags-20260927): userPlatform is the AIDS PlatformInfo PLAT on every identity (USER_PLATFORM_AIDS, 4 = pc); networkTopology is GAME.NTOP and N11 CONV.NTOP (NTOP, 130 = PEER_TO_PEER_FULL_MESH); initialGameSettings is GAME.GSET before any SetGameSettings (OSDK_GAME_SETTINGS, 0x2 OpenToMatchmaking); osdkRosterVersion is the GAME.ATTR OSDK_rosterVersion (OSDK_GAME_ATTRS); gameSetupTelemetryMicroseconds is NotifyGameSetup TELM and gameSetupJoinerResult the joiner's REAS.MMSC.RSLT (GAMESETUP_WIRE_FIX conservative); gameSpeed is the GAME.ATTR fifaGameSpeed both players read at match setup (0 Slow, 1 Normal, 2 Fast; Fast by default; null sends no key, which FIFA plays as Normal), and the panel's online.gameSpeed overrides it until the next restart. The limits bound what the OSDK attribute and Messaging relays accept.
_emptyRepliesComment: Requests the retail server answered with an empty payload: [component, command].
